content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Assistant Professor (Research) Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee, the age limit, a pay amount or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university, and its Amritapuri Campus is in Kollam, Kerala. These posts are in the Amrita School of Computing on that campus. The school is hiring research faculty in four areas of computing.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Assistant Professor (Research) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are invited in the following areas. The notice does not split the 5 posts between them. content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Assistant Professor (Research) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification, as printed: PhD /PhD thesis Submitted. The notice also says PhD in any discipline. The university lists the following profile for applicants: h-index above 10 At least 8 Scopus-indexed papers, with 3 of them in Q1 journals as first author Research experience at reputed institutions Preferred: candidates from IITs, NITs and other premier Indian institutes. See the official notification for the full eligibility for each research area.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Role
content_sections.text: Salary is paid as per university norms. The role offers: A research-focused position with minimal teaching, no more than 6 hours a week Opportunities to work with international researchers Opportunities to mentor PhD scholars

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of appointment: a two-year contract Place of posting: Amrita School of Computing, Amritapuri Campus, Kollam, Kerala

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Assistant Professor (Research) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Assistant Professor (Research) job page on the Amrita website (link below). Use the "Apply Now" / "Apply Online" option on that page to submit your application. Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026. Send any questions to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor (Research) posts are vacant at Amrita Amritapuri?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts at the Amrita School of Computing, Amritapuri Campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
Q3. Can I apply if I have submitted my PhD thesis but not yet received the degree?
faq.answer: Yes. The qualification is printed as "PhD /PhD thesis Submitted".

faq.question: Q4. Which research areas are covered?
faq.answer: Computer Science & Engineering, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, and Quantum Computing.

faq.question: Q5. What publication record is expected?
faq.answer: The university wants an h-index above 10 and at least 8 Scopus-indexed papers. Three of those papers must be in Q1 journals with the candidate as first author.

faq.question: Q6. How much teaching does the post involve?
faq.answer: Teaching is limited to no more than 6 hours a week, because the post is research-focused.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. The post is offered on a two-year contract.

faq.question: Q8. Who gets preference?
faq.answer: Candidates from IITs, NITs and other premier Indian institutes are preferred.
